svg.title: Andreja high-level architecture and data flows
svg.desc: Current Phase 1A components, current local conformance contracts, future gated components, six labelled trust boundaries, ten numbered data flows, local data custody, and extension seams.

text.tspan: Andreja high-level architecture and data flows
Phase 1A evidence view • one modular-monolith deployable • future capability is explicitly gated
User content follows policy-labelled flows only.
Never telemetry, public/help, or secret files.
Trust boundaries are labelled TB1–TB6. Flow numbers F1–F10 map to the companion document.
No app cookies or user data
Checksums; no credentials or key material
